title: Unlocking Your Divine Purpose & Calling: A Theological Exposition on Discerning and Walking in God's Sovereign Design
excerpt: Human existence is not an accidental byproduct of biological evolution; it is the intentional manifestation of a divine blueprint established before the foundation of the world. This treatise explores the biblical, theological, and practical framework for discovering, aligning with, and executing your heavenly calling.

title: Walking in Spiritual Authority: A Theological and Practical Exposition of the Believer's Position in Christ
excerpt: Every believer in Jesus Christ has been legally granted spiritual authority within the realm of creation. This treatise provides an in-depth biblical, theological, and practical analysis of what it means to comprehend, embrace, and exercise spiritual authority in Christ.

title: Workplace Conflict Resolution
excerpt: Learn how to resolve workplace conflict effectively with a practical 4-step framework rooted in biblical wisdom and leadership principles.
